name: Shear-Image Order Ray Casting
definition: A volume rendering method that renders sampled 3D data with image quality equivalent to full image order (ray-per-pixel) while retaining the computational complexity and spatial coherence of shear-warp. It eliminates the intermediate image and final warp step of shear-warp by casting rays through pixel centers and sampling at intersections with sheared slices, using a new factorization to preserve memory and interpolation efficiency.
summary: Shear-Image Order Ray Casting is a direct volume rendering method that achieves full image-order quality while retaining shear-warp efficiency by casting rays through sheared slices without intermediate warping.
